blocks.title: Iteration repeats instructions
blocks.text: Iteration means executing a block of instructions repeatedly. The loop needs a rule that determines whether another repetition happens.

blocks.title: for = count-controlled
blocks.text: The header sets the counter, tests whether the loop continues, then changes the counter after each repetition.

blocks.title: while = test before repeating
blocks.text: A while loop is useful when you do not know how many attempts will be needed. If the condition is false before the first test, the loop can execute zero times .

blocks.title: do...while = run first, test after
blocks.text: The body executes before the condition is checked, so it always runs at least once.
